capturedLocalE3.description: The capture wall time as the E3 time workflows read it: EXIF DateTimeOriginal, XMP photoshop:DateCreated, XMP exif:DateTimeOriginal and IPTC 2:55 with 2:60, so a correction can rewrite every copy it would otherwise leave stale. A different meaning from capturedLocal only in having more sources.
capturedLocalE3.label: Capture time (local wall time, every source)

capturedOffsetE3.description: The UTC offset recorded for the capture time, as +HH:MM within -12:00 to +14:00, from EXIF OffsetTimeOriginal, both XMP date suffixes and the IPTC 2:60 suffix. -00:00 is unreadable rather than UTC. Absent means no offset is recorded and none is inferred.
capturedOffsetE3.label: Recorded UTC offset of the capture time (every source)

capturedSubSecondE3.description: The decimal digits after the second of the capture time (EXIF SubSecTimeOriginal and the XMP fractions), kept as text so leading zeros survive. Absent when no source records a fraction. IPTC cannot hold a fraction.
capturedSubSecondE3.label: Capture time fraction of a second (every source)

capturedUtcE3.description: The capture instant in UTC, derived by exact arithmetic only when capturedLocalE3 and capturedOffsetE3 are both present and agree across every source. It inherits the doubts of a camera clock and proves nothing about when the photograph was really taken.
capturedUtcE3.label: Capture instant in UTC (derived, every source)

digitizedLocalE3.description: When the file says it was digitized, as wall time without a zone, from EXIF DateTimeDigitized, XMP xmp:CreateDate and IPTC 2:62 with 2:63. It can differ from the capture time for scans. Independent proof.
digitizedLocalE3.label: Digitization time (local wall time, every source)

digitizedOffset.description: The UTC offset recorded for the digitization time (EXIF OffsetTimeDigitized, the XMP xmp:CreateDate suffix and the IPTC 2:63 suffix) as +HH:MM. Absent means none is recorded and none is inferred.
digitizedOffset.label: Recorded UTC offset of the digitization time

digitizedSubSecond.description: The decimal digits after the second of the digitization time (EXIF SubSecTimeDigitized and the XMP xmp:CreateDate fraction), kept as text so leading zeros survive.
digitizedSubSecond.label: Digitization time fraction of a second

digitizedUtc.description: The digitization instant in UTC, derived by exact arithmetic only when digitizedLocalE3 and digitizedOffset are both present and agree. It inherits the doubts of a device clock.
digitizedUtc.label: Digitization instant in UTC (derived)

gpsDatumE3.description: The geodetic datum text recorded by EXIF GPSMapDatum and XMP exif:GPSMapDatum, exactly as written. Absent means unspecified: Schemaxis never infers WGS-84 and never converts datums.
gpsDatumE3.label: Recorded geodetic datum (EXIF and XMP)

gpsHorizontalError.description: The horizontal positioning error in metres that the file records (EXIF GPSHPositioningError), as a non-negative rational. It is what was written, never derived from a satellite count or track data, and it is not a measurement made here.
gpsHorizontalError.label: GPS horizontal positioning error

gpsLatitudeE3.description: Latitude in signed decimal degrees from the EXIF GPS rationals with the N/S reference, and from XMP exif:GPSLatitude. The stored seconds may be exactly 60 (a non-canonical but exact form ExifTool writes) and are summed exactly; minutes of 60 or more are unreadable, never carried. Location class; the datum is separate and nothing is converted.
gpsLatitudeE3.label: GPS latitude (every source, seconds of 60 accepted)

gpsLongitudeE3.description: Longitude in signed decimal degrees from the EXIF GPS rationals with the E/W reference, and from XMP exif:GPSLongitude. The stored seconds may be exactly 60 and are summed exactly; minutes of 60 or more are unreadable, never carried. Location class; the datum is separate and nothing is converted.
gpsLongitudeE3.label: GPS longitude (every source, seconds of 60 accepted)

gpsUtcExact.description: The GPS UTC instant, derived only when gpsUtcDate and gpsUtcTimeExact are both present, keeping an exact fraction of a second. It is the receiver clock, which can differ from the camera clock.
gpsUtcExact.label: GPS UTC instant with an exact fraction (derived)

gpsUtcTimeExact.description: The GPS time stamp (EXIF GPSTimeStamp, UTC) as HH:MM:SS with an exact decimal fraction of at most 9 digits when the stored seconds have one; denominators that are not a divisor of 10^9 are unsupported rather than rounded. Location class.
gpsUtcTimeExact.label: GPS UTC time of day with an exact fraction

modifiedOffset.description: The UTC offset recorded for the file modification time (EXIF OffsetTime and the XMP xmp:ModifyDate suffix) as +HH:MM. An edit time, not a capture time. Absent means none is recorded.
modifiedOffset.label: Recorded UTC offset of the modification time

modifiedSubSecond.description: The decimal digits after the second of the modification time (EXIF SubSecTime and the XMP xmp:ModifyDate fraction), kept as text so leading zeros survive.
modifiedSubSecond.label: Modification time fraction of a second

modifiedUtc.description: The modification instant in UTC, derived by exact arithmetic only when modifiedLocal and modifiedOffset are both present and agree. An edit time, not a capture time.
modifiedUtc.label: Modification instant in UTC (derived)
